tests.claim: Peer checks that run a new command find more failures than re-runs of an existing command
tests.test: Fisher exact; cluster bootstrap over projects for the risk difference
tests.note: 53 projects; resampling whole projects keeps repeated runs on one project together.

tests.claim: Peer runs on a revision the builder already passed rarely fail
tests.stat: 6 of 266 failed (2.3%); 3 of those were missing files

tests.claim: Residents' peer checks fail more often than judges'
tests.test: Fisher exact (crude) and Mantel–Haenszel stratified by check type
tests.stat: crude OR 2.46 (p = 0.053); within check type, pooled OR 1.60 (95% CI 0.70–3.65)
tests.note: Residents wrote new probes far more often than judges; the stratified estimate asks whether role matters once that is held fixed.

tests.claim: Specific change requests are acted on more often than requests for more evidence

tests.stat: changes requested 14/17 vs needs evidence 14/62; random times on the same projects 46%
tests.note: Null: 40 uniformly random time points per reviewed project, drawn within that project's active lifetime.
